subject: Possible to integrate download and upload w/ dropbox saver and chooser APIs

messages.author: 2974c1dd08b9969a
messages.subject: Possible to integrate download and upload w/ dropbox saver and chooser APIs
parts:
I'm currently working on a web application in Shiny in which the user can save the state of the various inputs to a file.  However, this is problematic on iOS devices as they do not grant the browser file system access for downloads and only allow image uploads.

Thankfully, dropbox has an API for allow web applications access to the user's dropbox account which works beatifully on iOS.  More info on these in links below:
Dropbox chooser: https://www.dropbox.com/developers/dropins/chooser/js
Dropbox saver: https://www.dropbox.com/developers/dropins/saver

I'm currently trying to integrate these so that the file chooser will pass the file over to Shiny and the saver will take files provided by Shiny's downloadhandler, but no luck so far.

Has anyone tried this before?  Any suggestions on how to go about it?
